name: Trent
title: Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the second quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026

read.thesis: Trent Q2 FY27 standalone merchandise revenue +23% and EBITDA +37% with EBIT margin 11.6% vs 10.5%, but PAT up only 9% on base effects; no capacity or supply-side metrics disclosed, so the read is demand-led growth in a retail roll-out.

triggers.label: Standalone revenue +23% YoY in Q2
triggers.quote: Revenue from sale of merchandise (excl. other operating income) grew by 23% and 21% during the quarter

triggers.label: Store additions: 19 Zudio, 10 Westside
triggers.quote: In Q2FY27 we opened 10 Westside and 19 Zudio stores and consolidated 2 Zudio stores.

red_flags.label: PAT growth lags EBITDA (+9% vs +37%) on base effect of Rs 96 Cr one-off gain
red_flags.quote: Other income for the previous year includes pre-tax profit on sale of assets of Rs. 96 Cr in Q2FY26

red_flags.label: Management says full-year, not quarter, is representative
red_flags.quote: We believe given our approach with respect to merchandise sourcing, price architecture, distribution and disciplines around inventory provisioning, the full year results are more representative

evasions.quote: the full year results are more representative of the performance of the business
